description: ASFINAG and RISC Software publish ATSD, annotated Austrian highway traffic scenes and cropped traffic signs. Images were acquired in 2014 and annotated in 2020–2021. Public training and test sets contain 5,511 full scenes and 20,527 sign annotations across 108 classes; a separate internal evaluation split is withheld. Cropped public images cover sixty frequent sign classes. The provider offers free access after registration and acceptance of its custom terms, with the download link sent by email. Images and annotations can train perception components or validate traffic-sign recognition in road simulations. Austrian signs and selected motorway conditions are a limitation on geographic transfer, and private evaluation images are unavailable. Files and registration were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Austrian Highway Traffic Sign Dataset
notes: G4-0463; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
